name: ADEPTUS
concept: An autonomous identity-escalation attacker for allowlisted lab web apps: crawls and harvests session artifacts (JWTs, cookies, role params), runs live token-schema inference to learn the app's auth grammar, mutates tokens against an escalation brain (alg confusion, HS256 rebase, HMAC brute, cookie/signature stripping, IDOR, role-param), climbs to the highest-privilege authenticated state, and wherever an SSRF sink surfaces uses it as a pivot to map and reach internal-only services (emulated metadata backend included). An optional operator-facing 'measure' mode bundles a stdlib-only honeypot detector harness (threshold, timing-entropy, UA-fingerprint, burst-correlation) grading the campaign's detection noise with a score-vs-knob matrix — evasion measurable inside the lab, not a stealth claim.
attack_vectors: JWT alg confusion + none/case-variant forging and RS256-to-HS256 rebase via discovered public keys
weak HMAC secret recovery (offline short-key/wordlist) then full token forgery
token replay & misuse: cross-endpoint replay, privilege rebinding, timestamp/expiry stretching
cookie tampering: signature stripping, role/flag bit-flip, predictable session-ID inference
IDOR object-ID traversal and role-parameter (isAdmin/groups[]/permission-claim) mutation escalation
SSRF sink discovery (url,next,redirect,uri,src,proxy,feed,fetch) with scheme/port/encoding-bypass canonicalized and proven in-allowlist
internal-surface mapping via SSRF pivot + file/gopher/dict reads + emulated 169.254.169.254 metadata token -> internal API auth
live token-schema inference: parse harvested samples to learn which fields the app's auth grammar checks, then mutate only those fields
optional measure mode: stdlib honeypot detector harness (threshold, timing-entropy, UA-fingerprint, burst correlation) grading per-campaign noise
novelty_angle: The loop is driven by live token-schema inference (read the app's own auth grammar before mutating), an evidence-based escalation brain ranks mutants by credibility to minimize request noise, and SSRF pivoting is fused into the same escalation path — with a bundled stdlib-only detector harness making evasion a measurable lab dimension.
dependencies: Python 3 stdlib only: http.server, urllib, base64, hmac, hashlib, ipaddress, socket, json, time, re, secrets
allowlist config file / --lab-cidr plus implicit loopback + RFC1918
optional PyJWT; pure-stdlib JWT parser otherwise
bundled session-secret wordlist + emulated 169.254.169.254 metadata endpoint (lab-only)
bundled stdlib-only honeypot detector harness for measure mode
scope_gate: Single canonicalizing resolver (loopback 127.0.0.0/8 + ::1, RFC1918, user --lab-cidr) gates every fetch, replay, mutation, escalation, SSRF pivot, and metadata path; all encoding variants normalized to canonical IP and hard-refused unless in-allowlist; metadata backend tied only to in-lab 169.254/16; callback listeners bound loopback; WARN banner + --confirm-lab on first run; honeypot detector runs only against operator-owned in-allowlist addresses.
